supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.13, p~1e-281; r2 0.825 with all 20 predictors.
Interaction coef 0.77, p~1e-77, delta_r2 0.062; holdout test R2 rises from 0.818 (main effects only) to 0.876 with X1:X3, so it generalizes out of sample.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant interaction (p~1e-77), delta R2 0.062, and holdout test R2 improved from 0.818 to 0.876.
Marginal p=0.046 with delta R2 0.0027; adding X2:X3 left holdout test R2 unchanged (0.876044 vs 0.876082), so no out-of-sample benefit. Likely a false positive.
Interaction p=0.52, delta R2 0.0002; no evidence of an interaction.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression only; no experimental or design evidence for causation.
Strong association but the data cannot establish causal direction or rule out confounding.
